change: S4: BRIEF_V3 + DAY SCORECARD + entry test (line v3, page v3.1) + S4.txt (7 rules)
basis: S3, 9 days, tag sline_s3 (Sonnet, BRIEF_V2, S3.txt). Cited trades are named in reports/recursive_loop/S4_independent_review.md section 5/6b. Group A = the rebuys/counter-direction entries the entry test targets (the case FOR); group C = the rule's PRICE and the grind working (cited so neither is hidden). Holdout NOT cited.

trades.group: A: REBUY right after a claim into a chop (06:00 S +$322 claim, then 06:15 S -$210 in 10 min)
trades.would_have: SHORT rebuy at 06:15 after the 06:00 short claim (+$322); lost -$210 in 10 min. S4 requires 15 min since the claim closed AND price beyond the claimed trade's best before a rejoin; the review labels this rebuy 'keep' under the old 'claim + still running' test, so S4's 15-min wait is the part that bites. Observer label, not a re-simulation.

trades.group: A: REBUY after RED ('worth rejoining after the last stop-out')
trades.would_have: Entered SHORT after the 06:15 red; the model's own reason was 'worth rejoining after the last stop-out'. S4 entry test: last trade was red, same MIL, so WAIT; this entry is labelled violating. Not a re-simulation.

trades.group: A: counter-direction LONG into a bounce, 10 min after a small green short
trades.would_have: LONG into a bounce inside a down leg, 10 min after a small green short; -$522, tied worst trade of S3. S4 entry test: same MIL, last trade not a claim, so WAIT. Observer label, not a re-simulation.

trades.group: A: LONG 5 min after a +$120 claim, small-claim rebuy
trades.would_have: LONG 5 min after a +$120 non-claim; small claims count for nothing in S4 (needs 2 ATR AND $200). Entry test fails: not a claim. Observer label.

trades.group: C: PRICE OF THE RULE - a 5-min +$478 LONG that a one-per-MIL gate labels 'after red'
trades.would_have: A +60.6pt LONG claim ($478, 3 ATR) held 5 min, labelled 'after red' by the gate and blocked. The rule's PRICE: a good trade the entry test would not have allowed. Cited so it is not hidden.

trades.group: C: PRICE OF THE RULE - +$608 SHORT claim after a red long (reversal the gate would block)
trades.would_have: SHORT +$608 claim after a red long; MIL had not flipped so the gate labels it same-MIL. The largest S3 winner the entry test would have blocked. The rule's PRICE.

trades.group: C: GRIND WORKING - claim then rebuy 10 min later, +$188
trades.would_have: The grind working: +$236 claim at 03:05, rebuy at 03:50 +$188. S4 allows it once 15 min have passed and price is beyond the claimed trade's best.

trades.group: C: GRIND WORKING - claim then rebuy 15 min later, +$296
trades.would_have: The grind working: third chained short +$296 after a claim. S4 allows it; the 05:55 rebuy (-$190, price back inside the exit) is the one S4 would block.
